name: Find the Mouse 🐭
desc:
🐭 Welcome to Find The Mouse! Search through the map and collect cute mouse!

🎮 How To Play:
🔎 Explore the maps to find all of the hidden mouse
🏆 Find all mouse the fastest for a spot on the leaderboard

🤝 Find mouse with friends and meet new friends along the way!
🎒 Equip the mouse you collect!
📜 What's new? - A haunted biome has risen from the shadows, and 16 spooky mouse have crept into the index!
